title: Hearty Juicy French Seitan Terrine
description: A vegan-friendly French dish featuring seitan, black olives, and rest-meat, packed with umami flavor and juicy texture, all in one pot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, saute the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the seitan, black olives, tomato paste, vegetable broth, nutritional yeast, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
Stir well to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Strain the mixture through a cheesecloth or fine-mesh sieve into a terrine mold.
Refrigerate the terrine for at least 2 hours to set.
